label: AB4C_hP12_186_b_bc_b-002
title: High-temperature LiBH$_{4}$ structure
comments:
This is the high-temperature structure of LiBH$_{4}$, with the data taken at 408K.  Below $\approx$ 321K (Souli\'{e}, 2002) it transforms into a \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oP24_62_c_2cd_c-002}{low-temperature orthorhombic structure}. 
 Space group $P6_{3}mc$ \#186 is polar, with no fixed origin for the z-axis.  We follow (Souli\'{e}, 2002) and set $z_{2} = 0$ for the lithium site. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_hP12_186_b_bc_b-001}{High-temperature tridymite AlPO$_{4}$} and \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_hP12_186_b_bc_b-002}{high-temperature LiBH$_{4}$} have the same AFLOW prototype label, AB4C\_hP12\_186\_b\_bc\_b. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files.
